query:
Go to http://localhost:7770/catalogsearch/result/?q=Calderwood . Across all the Calderwood listings, which seller is cheapest for the 2 x 9.5L pack, and what is that price?

Before answering, open every listing in the search results, including any on later pages, and check the relevant option on each one. Do not stop early because a listing looks unpromising from its search-result price. Base the answer only on listings you have opened, and say how many you opened.

result.final: After opening all 15 Calderwood listings across both pages of search results, the cheapest seller for the 2 x 9.5L pack is Bramley Trading at $17.36 ($6.39 base price + $10.97 surcharge for 2 x 9.5L option). I opened 15 listings total.

page.title: Calderwood Still Spring Water, Multipack - Bramley Trading
